feeds.title: Early On Set Blog
feeds.description: Early onset Alzheimer's only affects about 5 percent of people who develop Alzheimer's and begins prior to 65 years of age. When it happened to the husband of blogger Linda Fisher in 2008, she was inspired to launch a blog that provides wisdom, support, heartfelt stories, and practical advice for people who have Alzheimer's as well as their caregivers.

feeds.title: Alzheimer's Speaks Blog
feeds.description: Alzheimer's erases memories and takes the power of speech with it, preventing people with the disease from expressing their needs and wants. Alzheimer's Speaks is a mouthpiece for those silenced. It also serves as an outlet for caregivers and loved ones too overwhelmed to have their say.

feeds.title: Dementia by Day Blog
feeds.description: Rachael Wonderlin is a dementia care consultant and owner of Dementia By Day. Author of 'When Someone You Know is Living in a Dementia Care Community'

feeds.title: Let's Talk about Dementia
feeds.description: Let's Talk about Dementia was set up following on from Scotland's Dementia Awareness Week 2014 which focussed on the theme 'lets talk about dementia'. It covers a range of topics and offer practical ideas, hint and tips, share allied health professionals' knowledge and expertise.

feeds.title: Lewy Body Dementia Blog
feeds.description: The mission of the Lewy Body Dementia Resource Center of New York is to raise crucially needed awareness of Lewy Body Dementia through the dissemination of information to health care professionals and the general public. Offer loving support and services to people with LBD and their care partners in the New York area. Promote essential scientific advances.

feeds.title: ASC Senior Living Blog
feeds.description: Find useful information about Alzheimer's and memory care on our blog. ASC provides person-centered memory care in a safe, caring environment.

feeds.title: The Caregivers Voice Blog
feeds.description: The Caregivers Voice brings informative, inspirational, and humorous caregiving articles for caregivers caring for loved ones with Dementia & Alzheimer's. Founded in 1998 by Brenda Avadian, MA

feeds.title: Alzheimers Association of Northern California and Northern Nevada Blog
feeds.description: The Alzheimer's Association is the leading voluntary health organization in Alzheimer care, support and research. Our mission is to eliminate Alzheimer's disease through the advancement of research; to provide and enhance care and support for all affected; and to reduce the risk of dementia through the promotion of brain health.

feeds.title: Kate Swaffer Blog
feeds.description: Kateswaffer.com is committed to meaningful dialogue with a wide range of stakeholders about the critical issues impacting a person living with a diagnosis of dementia and their families, close friends, academics, and health care professionals, as we ll as civil society. In this blog, Kate Swaffer explores the daily challenges of living with and beyond dementia.

feeds.title: Amazing Place
feeds.description: A great resource for anyone impacted by dementia. Find meaningful resources, insights, and more to help you along your journey. At Amazing Place, we are empowering lives disrupted by dementia and ending the stigma of dementia.

feeds.title: GERDA SAUNDERS Blog
feeds.description: Notes about Gerda's microvascular disease and dementia, news about my new book named Memory's Last Breath.

feeds.title: George Rook
feeds.description: Hello, I'm George Rook. I have dementia at 63! I write this blog because I want people to know my story so it may influence change. Read my updates and take action to make living better for people with dementia.

feeds.title: Association For Dementia Studies Blog
feeds.description: Association for Dementia Studies (ADS) works to improve the lives of people living with dementia, their families, and those who work to support them. It is an active research and education center at the University of Worcester. Read our blog to know more about us, how we work, what we do, and more!

feeds.title: Living With Dementia
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Pete Middleton. In my blog, Living With Dementia, I document my journey into dementia and show how I cope day-to-day with the challenges of this chronic disease that steals memories and strips away abilities. Please come along with me for the ride, and together we will experience the ups and downs of life after diagnosis.

feeds.title: AlzheimersLab
feeds.description: AlzheimersLab.com is a resource for the family members of those suffering from dementia and other cognitive diseases. It is focused on relaying research-backed information to the family members. The goal is to keep you updated with the latest breakthroughs, products, and news on the subject of dementia.

feeds.title: Dementia Map Blog
feeds.description: Dementia Map offers the most valuable and comprehensive list of dementia resources in your backyard - or around the world! The Dementia Map Blog is your home to all news, information, and a wealth of reference materials - for both visitors and members alike.

feeds.title: lightheartmemorycare
feeds.description: Light Heart Memory Care is an Alzheimer's facility, committed toenriching the lives of people diagnosed with Alzheimer's and otherdementias.

feeds.title: Interdem
feeds.description: Interdem is a pan-European network of researchers collaborating in research on and dissemination of Early, Timely and Quality Psychosocial Interventions in Dementia aimed at improving the quality of life of people with dementia and their supporters, across Europe.

feeds.title: Sunshine Coast Dementia Network
feeds.description: The Sunshine Coast's central network for those affected by dementia

feeds.title: I'll Always Remember Blog
feeds.description: A blog about early onset dementia from a mother's perspective. Gay Lewis' daughter, Shelley, was diagnosed in 2014 with dementia. Through this blog, Gay shares their journey, and their many struggles, on this difficult road. She hopes her story can help others also facing this disease.

feeds.title: To The Rescue Blog
feeds.description: To The Rescue provides personalized and specialized care in helping the elderly, Alzheimer's, disabled and those recovering from illness or injury.

feeds.title: Alzheimer Review
feeds.description: An Alzheimer review blog by Michael Pekker on everything about Alzheimer disease: Causes, Symptoms, Treatment and more.

feeds.title: Seeking The Good Life
feeds.description: This is the story of Paul and Maureen's journey after Maureen's diagnosis of dementia following stroke in February 2014 and now has mixed dementia. 'Dharma For Dementia' is his approach to being Maureem's Care Partner it aims to end the suffering of 'Prescribed Disengagement' (Swaffer) .

feeds.title: Dementia Alliance of North Carolina Blog
feeds.description: Dementia Alliance of NC is committed to improve the lives of all North Carolinians impacted by dementia, engaging and empowering them through support, education and research.

feeds.title: Lewy Body Dementia Association Blog
feeds.description: The Lewy Body Dementia Association is a nonprofit organization dedicated to raising awareness of the Lewy body dementias, supporting people with LBD, their families and caregivers and promoting scientific advances. The Association's purposes are charitable, educational, and scientific.

feeds.title: Long Island Alzheimer's and Dementia Center Blog
feeds.description: Harvard study links loss of metal lithium to Alzheimer's Disease, bringing renewed hope for patients and families on Long Island. Read Newsday!

feeds.title: Dementia Researcher Blog
feeds.description: Blogs written by Dementia Researchers for Dementia Researchers. Talking careers, life, science and research, sharing tips to help you and your work and career.

feeds.title: Hearts for Dementia Blog
feeds.description: Explore our heartfelt blog for dementia care tips, personal stories, and expert advice. Empower yourself with knowledge and community support.

feeds.title: Silverado » Dementia & Alzheimer's
feeds.description: The Silverado Dementia and Alzheimer's section offers simple, helpful articles about memory care, early signs of dementia, stages of Alzheimer's, brain health tips, and support for families. It provides guidance on understanding symptoms, getting a diagnosis, and caring for loved ones, with information based on Silverado's experience as a memory care provider.

feeds.title: DementiaWho! Blog
feeds.description: DementiaWho is a personal blog created by a full-time caregiver who shares practical tips, experiences, and supportive guidance from caring for a parent with Alzheimer's disease, with a focus on helping caregivers and raising awareness in diverse communities.

feeds.title: Dementia Society Blog
feeds.description: We are your leading volunteer, all-Dementias nonprofit in America. Find local resources, donate to help others, learn about Dementia, and more.

feeds.title: Live with Dementia Blog
feeds.description: The blog section of Live With Dementia provides supportive articles for dementia care partners, covering topics such as first steps post-diagnosis, personal preference care planning, and tools for caregivers. It aims to help those caring for someone with Alzheimer's or other types of dementia navigate daily challenges, build confidence, and find connection through shared experiences.

feeds.title: Dementia Careblazers Blog
feeds.description: Care Blazers is a blog and resource hub focused on dementia care. It offers articles that help family and professional caregivers understand dementia types, manage behaviors, and support daily caregiving challenges. The content emphasizes practical strategies, evidence-based tips, and real-life caregiving scenarios, all aimed at making caregiving less overwhelming and more confident.

feeds.title: Mobile Memory Enrichment Blog
feeds.description: Explore expert insights on dementia care, caregiver support, and holistic activities in the Mobile Memory Enrichment blog. Stay informed and empowered.

feeds.title: NCCDP Blog
feeds.description: Our blog is your trusted source for the latest insights, best practices, and breakthroughs in Alzheimer's Disease and dementia care. Dive in to stay informed and inspired as we explore the ever-evolving landscape of memory care.

feeds.title: Juliette Fowler Communities Blog
feeds.description: Their blog highlights stories and updates about senior living, memory support, youth services, and community engagement. It features articles like how their memory support programs help residents living with dementia, awards for advocacy efforts, and ways the organization connects across generations.

feeds.title: Terra Vista Memory Care Blog
feeds.description: Read our memory care blogs and discover information about Alzheimer's and dementia care here.

feeds.title: HOPE Dementia Support blog
feeds.description: The blog section on the website of HOPE Dementia Support shares compassionate stories and practical advice for caregivers and individuals affected by dementia. It offers personal reflections, caregiving tips, and insights aimed at helping readers feel less isolated and more empowered in their journey.

feeds.title: James L West Blog
feeds.description: The blog on the James L. West Center for Dementia Care website shares articles aimed at both caregivers and professionals, covering topics such as nutrition's impact on dementia progression, the role of support groups, caregiver health, and the emotional and behavioral aspects of caring for people with dementia.

feeds.title: Arden Courts Blog
feeds.description: The blog section of Arden Courts offers clear and caring posts focused on memory care for those with Alzheimer's and related dementias. It covers topics such as moving to memory care, recognizing early dementia signs, creating safe environments, self-care for caregivers, and comparing different senior living options.

feeds.title: Dementia Research UK Blog
feeds.description: Latest news from our partners in dementia research Here you will find insights, news and developments from our expert contributors, our supporters and our charity team. If you have any comments about the Blog or any topics you would like us to cover.

feeds.title: DPUK Blog
feeds.description: Browse our blog for an insight into the vital work our researchers are doing to tackle dementia. We also explain more about the different types, symptoms and risk factors of dementia, busting the jargon and offering helpful tips and advice.

feeds.title: Dementia Carers Count News
feeds.description: If you're caring for someone with dementia, discover our great resource of informative and personal blogs and articles here. Dementia Carers Count is working for a world where all family and friends taking care of someone with dementia feel confident, supported, and heard.

feeds.title: B&M Care Homes
feeds.description: B&M Care is a private residential and specialist dementia care provider with a current portfolio of 26 care homes in and around the Home Counties. From achievements and care staff successes to advice, support, and day-in-the-life features, the B&M Care Blog is a regularly updated portal that better connects you to one of the most recognized brands within the specialist dementia care sector.

feeds.title: Dementia Services Development Centre Blog
feeds.description: The blog section of the Dementia Services Development Centre (DSDC) at University of Stirling in Scotland features articles on best practices in dementia care, research updates, design for dementia environments, inclusive support for carers, and real-world case studies.

feeds.title: PillarCare Blog » Dementia
feeds.description: The Dementia Care Blogs section on PillarCare provides practical articles for families and caregivers, offering guidance on topics like sundowning, choosing between live-in care and care homes, memory cafes, and how music can support people living with dementia.

feeds.title: Innovations in Dementia Blog
feeds.description: The blog section of Innovations in Dementia presents articles and posts focused on the experiences, rights, and needs of people living with dementia, with an emphasis on human‑rights approaches and the voices of people with dementia themselves.

feeds.title: The Guardian | Dementia
feeds.description: Latest news and features from theguardian.com on Dementia, the world's leading liberal voice.

feeds.title: Dealing with Dementia
feeds.description: Dealing With Dementia is a caregiver's journey to deliver purpose with grace and humor. Author Kay H. Bransford started this blog before her parents were simultaneously diagnosed with two different forms of dementia - Dad had Alzheimer's and Mom had Vascular Dementia.

feeds.title: Which Me Am I Today Blog
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Wendy. On the 31st July 2014, I was diagnosed with Young-onset dementia. I started this blog to write all my thoughts before they're lost. Luckily the part of my brain that allows me to type hasn't broken yet & I find that easier than talking. I have calendars that take care of the future but this blog serves as a reminder of what I've done & said in the past - it now serves as my memory. If anyone chooses to follow my ramblings it will serve as a way of raising awareness.

feeds.title: Us Against Alzheimers Blog
feeds.description: UsAgainstAlzheimer's is a national advocacy campaign and independent advocacy network committed to stopping Alzheimer's by 2020. By joining this movement, you will be working to advance policies to prevent, treat and cure Alzheimer's disease in our lifetime.

feeds.title: Dementia Sherpa
feeds.description: Christy is the go-to local expert for families living with a dementia diagnosis and the challenges that come with it. Christy is a speaker, founder of DementiaSherpa.com, and a community education instructor. Christy's mission is that every person living with dementia be treated with respect, kindness, and love and that their families be supported along the way.

feeds.title: World Young Leaders in Dementia (WYLD)
feeds.description: The World Young Leaders in Dementia (WYLD) is a network of passionate, young professionals working across disciplines and borders to develop innovative dementia solutions. They are millennials from clinical, academic, care, advocacy and commercial backgrounds who have united to improve the lives of people with dementia across the globe.

feeds.title: My Alzheimer's Story
feeds.description: Advocating for better care.This blog shares resources, news, and stories on Alzheimer's disease and caregiving.

feeds.title: Personalized Dementia Solutions
feeds.description: Personalized Dementia Solutions Inc. was founded by Karen Tyrell, CDP, CPCA with a passion for assisting those who are affected by Alzheimer's disease and other related dementias and their caregivers. Our expertise is providing creative solutions to help managing anxieties and other behaviours that are common for those affected by dementia in all stages.

feeds.title: Truthful Loving Kindness
feeds.description: A blog by the person with dementia symptoms. In this blog, I will primarily focus on dementia symptoms, strategies, communication, and relationship from a 1st-person perspective. I also regularly discuss the role that spirituality plays in my daily life.

feeds.title: Living With Lewy Body Dementia and Comorbidities
feeds.description: A blog raising awareness of Lewy Body Dementia.

feeds.title: Finding peace with in, foundation of the mind
feeds.description: I am the owner of Serenity Alzheimer's and Dementia Training by Alicia A. Reid LLC. On this site, we will engage in conversations involving Alzheimer's and Dementia. I will post discussion topics and articles to receive feedback. I feel this platform should help patients/clients and caregivers get closer to questions and concerns. Also, this platform is to bing and give knowledge to all.

feeds.title: Julia's Dementia Blog
feeds.description: Hello there, Julia's Dementia Blog is about what I learned about promoting wellbeing for my mother who lived with dementia. I set up this blog to share ideas & strategies about supporting someone who is living with dementia. It is meant for other people who have relatives with the disease. I would like to start a conversation with people who are going through similar experiences & professionals who have the expertise to share.

feeds.title: Living in the Shadow of Alzheimer's Blog
feeds.description: When Sheri's husband, Bob, was diagnosed with Alzheimer's and frontal lobe dementia, she felt as if a new and unwelcome visitor had permanently moved in with them. She named that visitor 'Al.' Her blog posts chronicle what it's like living with both her husband and his uninvited guest. Ranging from one-sentence anecdotes to poems, each blog packs an emotional punch.

feeds.title: Primrose Blog
feeds.description: Primrose Alzheimer's Living, Inc. is a California corporation providing services to individuals with memory impairments. Primrose, unlike other assisted living companies, focuses exclusively on adults who have Alzheimer's disease and related forms of dementia. Offering a full continuum of Alzheimer's services sets Primrose apart from other Alzheimer's assisted living companies.

feeds.title: Local Dementia Guide
feeds.description: Local Dementia Guide will help you to find local dementia support and resources in your area.

feeds.title: D4Dementia
feeds.description: Beth aims to provide support and advice through D4Dementia to those faced with vascular dementia and similar situations, inform and educate care professionals and the wider population, promote debate and create improvements in dementia care.

feeds.title: Dementia Diaries: A Journey With Dementia
feeds.description: I created this page to share our journey of dementia with my mom, as well as to create a place of support, awareness and resource for others. Please follow my official blog to view all content I post.

feeds.title: Aging Matters Inc. Blog
feeds.description: Aging Matters (AMI) provides Alzheimer, dementia and elder care in Orange County, CA and the San Francisco Bay Area.

feeds.title: dementia views you can use
feeds.description: Susan Berg, dementia expert and health care professional shares practical help for caregivers of those with dementia including easy to do activities.

feeds.title: Dementia: Living with it Graciously :: Support for Dementia Caregivers
feeds.description: This blog is written to provide information & support to persons who are providing care for someone with dementia. A first indicator of dementia is when someone has trouble doing a task once familiar & easy for them. If you have begun to be concerned about someone's memory or cognitive processing, help the person receive a physical exam to include lab work & an appointment with neuropsychologist.

feeds.title: Dementia Be Damned
feeds.description: A blog about an intellectually challenged woman Lyn's early onset Alzheimer's Disease.

feeds.title: Alzheimer Society Blog
feeds.description: The Alzheimer Society is Canada's leading nationwide health charity for people living with Alzheimer's disease and other dementias. Active in communities right across Canada, the Society offers programs and services for people living with dementia.

feeds.title: Dementia Daze Dosage
feeds.description: Dementia is not just losing your memory. It changes every aspect of your life including Social Interaction, Communication, Reasoning, Emotions, Reading Ability, and on and on. Through my blog, dementiadaze.com, I am hoping others will better understand this disease, PWD (Persons With Dementia) will find encouragement, and Care Givers will get a glimpse of our feelings. While I am still able, I share my journey through the progressing stages in hopes of helping others through their path.

feeds.title: talkhealth Dementia
feeds.description: A blog about dementia including Alzheimers and associated conditions. The talkhealth blogs are one of the leading health blog sites, bringing together the widest range of health subjects from a diverse set of bloggers.

feeds.title: The Lewy Body Rollercoaster
feeds.description: A blog by Lewy Body Tools educators Jim and Helen Whitworths on thoughts, current information and ideas about Lewy body disorders: Lewy body dementia, Parkinson's disease dementia and dementia with Lewy bodies.

feeds.title: Doctor Dementia and the Dementia Adventure
feeds.description: Carrie Peterson have over 30 years experience volunteering and working with aging adults, and have worked as a caregiver for Alzheimer's disease and other dementias and other neurological disorders both in the US and in Denmark. She have a passion for working with older adults and for working in all things dementia.

feeds.title: Dementia Downunder
feeds.description: 'Dementia Downunder' by Brett Partington is a blog site for anyone in Australia impacted by dementia. His aim is to help other families by documenting his journey, sharing information & experiences and telling our personal story of how we battled Alzheimer's Disease as a family. This website is suited for people with dementia, carers & family members.

feeds.title: AARP Blog
feeds.description: AARP is a nonprofit, nonpartisan organization that empowers people to choose how they live as they age. AARP is doing amazing things to make life better for today's 50-plus population and generations that follow. In the face of constantly changing realities, AARP is a champion for social change. Explore our articles written with the purpose of empowering you to take control of your Brain Health as you age. Find recipes, health and nutrition tips, fitness advice and more!

feeds.title: Voise Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Explore our Dementia Blog. Discover powerful insights, latest research, real stories, and the transformative work of the Voise Foundation.

feeds.title: California CareGivers » Dementia
feeds.description: The blog section offers articles and resources focused on dementia and Alzheimer's care, addressing topics such as caregiver support, medication management, stigma reduction, and health & wellness for seniors. It aims to help family members and professional caregivers by providing practical insights and guidance for caring for loved ones with cognitive decline.

feeds.title: NAZADA Blog
feeds.description: Read the latest news and updates on Alzheimer's from Northern Arizona Alzheimer's and Dementia Alliance in Flagstaff, AZ.

feeds.title: Silver Care Dementia Center Blog
feeds.description: Silver Care Dementia Center in Norfolk, Virginia is a nonprofit organization that supports people living with dementia by offering a safe social space, respite programs, and caregiver education. Their blog shares updates on new programs, community events, and dementia care initiatives.

feeds.title: Arthur's Senior Care Blog
feeds.description: Arthur's Residential Care provides personalized assisted living and memory care in two six-bedroom homes located in beautiful residential neighborhoods in Roseville and Shoreview, Minnesota in suburban Minneapolis-St. Paul. We provide expert care for clients in all stages of Alzheimer's disease and other types of dementia, as well as for conditions such as Parkinson's, Multiple Sclerosis, and ALS.

feeds.title: Alzheimer's & Dementia Weekly
feeds.description: This blog offers a unique community of people who all share the experiences of dementias such as Alzheimer's, whether as people with this handicap, professionals, caregivers, family or friends. We are dedicated to help preserve the dignity of patients and caregivers who are struggling with dementias.

feeds.title: Alzheimer's Disease International Blog
feeds.description: Alzheimer's Disease International (ADI) is the global voice on dementia. ADI's vision is an improved quality of life for people with dementia and their families throughout the world. They aim to help establish and strengthen Alzheimer associations throughout the world and to raise global awareness about Alzheimer's disease and all other causes of dementia.

feeds.title: Dementia Journey
feeds.description: Deborah Shouse author of 'Love in the Land of Dementia: Finding Hope in the Caregiver's Journey' and 'Connecting in the Land of Dementia: Creative Activities to Explore Together' shares how dementia changed her life

feeds.title: Alzheimer Society of Toronto
feeds.description: The mission of the Alzheimer Society is to alleviate the personal and social consequences of Alzheimer's disease and other dementias and to promote research. The role of the Alzheimer Society of Toronto is to offer support, information and education to people with dementia, their families and their caregivers, to increase public awareness of dementia, to promote research, and to advocate.

feeds.title: Peace with Dementia Rosary
feeds.description: Peace with Dementia Rosary is for persons living with dementia and their care partners, families and friends. Our mission is to use the power of prayer to help our community find peace on this journey with dementia.

feeds.title: Alzheimers.net Blog
feeds.description: Alzheimers.net is an online community dedicated to advocacy, education and supporting those whose lives have been impacted by Alzheimer's disease and other forms of dementia. Get the latest dementia and Alzheimer's information, news, research, treatment options, caregiver stories and community support.

feeds.title: Holistic Health, Natural Treatments Alzheimer's/Dementia
feeds.description: Dr. Henry Sobo is a Holistic Medicine Specialist in Stamford, CT, specializing in Anti-Aging and Alzheimer's/Dementia medicine and using only natural treatments.
